It is further alleged in the complaint that in September, 2015, she returned to India from Swaziland for 11 days.

The petitioner - accused No.1,
during brief stay, has taken all money and jewelleries of respondent No.2 - Complainant.

It is further alleged that during her stay in Swaziland, petitioner - accused No.1 has not taken care of respondent No.2 and has forcibly transferred amount to the account of mother-in-law assuring that he would return said money.
In the complaint, she also alleges ill-treatment by the in-laws of the complainant i.e., accused Nos.2 and 3 and sister-in- law and husband of sister-in-law i.e., accused Nos.4 and 5.

The present complaint is lodged alleging that the incident occurred in the year 2015 for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 498A, 504 read with 34 of IPC.
